## DG5 round 1, qa-verifier: verdict PASS, with three new Low findings, none blocking

Candidate `sha256:8df7f922775ffe8134d0f1c9848d94aa7d16a315997211bcb162ad727d88b74c` (2194 files, source `270ebbf`) matched at the start and the end of the review, in a complete clone and in the working tree. All 78 assigned requirements were checked. The record and the findings sidecar pass the gate schemas, and every evidence path they cite exists. Nothing in the product was changed, and the disposable clone has been removed.

### What ran
- **Static checks:** 7/7 passed (build, typecheck, lint, OpenAPI lint with 846 operations, no-CDN, format, contrast).
- **Unit tests:** 4/4 runs passed inside the load limit (max load 6.59), on Node 22 and 24 in both locale settings: 2341, 1722 and 259 tests, plus 2 skips that are intentional. An earlier series ran while all three reviews loaded the machine; there, one run exited 1 on a Vitest internal timeout although every test passed. It's reported as context only.
- **Integration, twice:** 3076 passed plus 1 intentional skip, both times. Migrations 0001–0097 applied, the contract test passed, and every `p5-pending` list is empty.
- **`tests/qa` alone:** 336/336. The REQ-DLV-037 suites on this candidate: A06 27, A07 12, A15 34, A16 30.
- **Product e2e:** 459/460 in each locale setting. The one failure is a timeout in a dashboard test; no assertion failed, and the spec passes 42/42 alone (F-DG5-141).
- **Root acceptance specs:** 30/30 with the locale unset. With C.UTF-8, 29/30: A22 failed on a test race and passes 6/6 alone (F-DG5-142).
- **Demo-stack specs:** 12/12 in both settings.
- **Validators:** register, pipeline and historical DG4, DG3, DG2 and DG1 all pass.

### My own probes of the clauses the register says are only partly covered
- **REQ-PB-093:** done entirely in the Studio UI, in en and ar. Publishing weights that total 95 % is refused. Weights 30/20/20/15/15 with a new Feasibility rubric reach only transformations created afterwards.
- **REQ-PB-090:** the traceability screen itself shows all three playbook chains, label by label.
- **REQ-S21-001:** an approval opened from the inbox shows the synthetic approval label.
- **REQ-S13-008:** the executive-pack PDF labels a pending benefit value as provisional, in both languages.
- **Auditor (read-only) pass over 32 P5 screens:** no write requests, no horizontal scrolling at 390 px or 200 % text, and no serious accessibility issues.
- **Export samples (REQ-DLV-037):** 82 files were checked in both languages. I couldn't render them as images: LibreOffice can't start because `/tmp` is read-only in this sandbox. So the inspection is of file content and structure, not visual.

### Findings
| ID | Severity | Requirement | Issue |
|---|---|---|---|
| F-DG5-140 | Low | REQ-S06-002 | The read-only auditor sees an enabled "Launch a procedure" form. The server correctly refuses with 403 and creates nothing, but no other screen offers the auditor an action. |
| F-DG5-141 | Low | REQ-S15-009 | `p4-dashboards.spec.ts:295` has no explicit time budget and timed out at 30 s in chromium-ar in both full runs. Most of the time goes to full-page screenshots, and no request was slow. |
| F-DG5-142 | Low | REQ-S12-022 | The A22 spec compares two reads of "next run" taken at different moments, so it fails whenever a 15-minute schedule boundary falls between them. The product is correct. |

### Disclosed in the evidence
- **First clone:** it failed for lack of disk space, so I used a non-shallow clone that leaves out only evidence folders, none of which are part of the candidate.
- **My own mistakes:** two first-attempt errors in my probes were fixed and re-run.
- **Validators in the clone:** they fail only because that clone lacks the evidence folders; every one of the 12,689 error lines is of that kind.
- **Disk space:** I deleted old Playwright trace files during the runs to protect the shared disk.

Everything is in `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG5/qa/round-1/`; start with `RUN-NOTES.md`.

Files are in `docs/delivery/reviews/DG5/round-1/`:
- qa-verifier.json
- qa-verifier.findings.json
- qa-verifier.md
